rationale: The interpreter output omits several required input fields and validation details present in the ticket, and it leaves multiple ambiguities unresolved. Each missing requirement, missing validation constraint, and each listed ambiguity is captured as a finding, preventing a PASS status.

findings.description: The ticket includes an "ASHRAE Summer Design" numeric input, but the interpreter output does not capture this field.
findings.action: Clarify whether the ASHRAE Summer Design value should be recorded and, if so, include it in the captured condenser parameters.

findings.description: The ticket defines a "Default Condenser" checkbox, but the interpreter output does not mention capturing its value.
findings.action: Specify the purpose of the Default Condenser checkbox and ensure its state is recorded in the system.

findings.description: The ticket defines a "High Amb. / Altit. Cond." checkbox, but the interpreter output does not mention capturing its value.
findings.action: Specify the purpose of the High Amb. / Altit. Cond. checkbox and ensure its state is recorded in the system.

findings.description: The acceptance criteria reference "per‑circuit cooling configurations", but the interpreter output does not capture any per‑circuit data.
findings.action: Clarify the required per‑circuit cooling configuration inputs and include them in the captured data model.

findings.description: One acceptance criterion mentions recording "coil geometry" for AC condensers, yet no coil‑geometry fields appear in the ticket tables and the interpreter does not address this.
findings.action: Provide the definition and input fields for coil geometry, or clarify that it is not required.

findings.description: The ticket allows temperature inputs in both °F and °C, but does not define conversion or display rules.
findings.action: Define unit‑conversion behavior and display formatting for temperature fields that accept both units.

sourceRefs.quote: Unit handling for fields that accept both °F and °C is not defined

findings.description: The purpose and validation constraints for the "Copies of this Bank" numeric input are not described in the ticket.
findings.action: Clarify the allowed range, required validation, and business meaning of the Copies of this Bank field.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify validation rules for the "Default Condenser" and "High Amb. / Altit. Cond." checkboxes.
findings.action: Provide validation requirements (e.g., mutual exclusivity, required selection) for these checkboxes.

sourceRefs.quote: "Default Condenser" and "High Amb. / Altit. Cond." checkboxes

findings.description: The exact list of Roof Type options (beyond "dark" and "light") and how parapet/shrouding is represented is not specified.
findings.action: Obtain clarification on the full set of Roof Type options and the representation format for parapet/shrouding.

sourceRefs.quote: The exact list of Roof Type options (beyond "dark" and "light") and how parapet/shrouding is represented (separate flags or combined options) is not specified.

findings.description: The catalog of valid EC Model values is referenced but not enumerated in the ticket.
